## Shared Spec Context
Resolve all 19 `SHOULD-FIX` findings identified in the `1.3.0` release audit (`VERDICT: GO-WITH-RISK`) across ADLC gates, CLI flag validation, doctor repo guard, scheduler `hollow-test` sandboxing, sidecar token enforcement, policy-guard case normalization, supply-chain hardening, model catalog synchronization, skill docs, changelog, website documentation, and distribution bundles.

Standing frozen rails across all tickets: `lib/lock.mjs`, `lib/gates.mjs`, `.adlc/config.json`.

```mermaid
graph TD
  T1["Ticket 1: T-AUDIT-1 — Harden ADLC gate error handling and script extraction"]
  T2["Ticket 2: T-AUDIT-2 — Strict CLI flag validation and doctor --fix repo guard"]
  T3["Ticket 3: T-AUDIT-3 — Sandbox post-merge hollow-test and enforce sidecar token auth"]
  T4["Ticket 4: T-AUDIT-4 — Policy workflow case normalization, bundle-externals parser, OIDC-only publish"]
  T5["Ticket 5: T-AUDIT-5 — Sync models.json, fix agb-run docs, update CHANGELOG/website, rebuild bundles"]
  T1 --> T5
  T2 --> T5
  T3 --> T5
  T4 --> T5
```

## Ticket T-AUDIT-5: Sync models.json, fix agb-run docs, update CHANGELOG/website, rebuild bundles
- **Scope**: `CHANGELOG.md`, `skills/**`, `commands/agb-run.md`, `website/**`, `dist/**`
- **Rails**: `lib/lock.mjs`, `lib/gates.mjs`, `.adlc/config.json`
- **Tier**: `mid`

#### Requirements
1. **Sync `skills/adversarial-review/references/models.json`:**
   - Run `node scripts/sync-models.mjs --write --offline` so `skills/adversarial-review/references/models.json` includes all models from `lib/models.mjs` (including `gemini-4-carbon-*`, `gemini-4-hydrogen-*`, `gemini-pro-orchestrator*`).
2. **Fix `skills/agb-run/SKILL.md` and `commands/agb-run.md`:**
   - Remove unsupported `project` and `cwd` parameters from the `mcp__agb__agb_run` invocation documentation so it matches `mcp/server.mjs` (which accepts only `plan`).
3. **Update `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`):**
   - Document the following entries under `[Unreleased]` (`### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Fixed`):
     - **PR #154 (`2e853e3`)**: Normalize `package-lock.json` `bin` field handling in `scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs` and isolate integration worktree git config and base-ref handling in `lib/worktrees.mjs`.
     - **PR #157 (`91e06a2`)**: Autonomous factory parity — new CLI commands/flags `shape`, `watch`, `init`, `sync-models`, `run -c <n>`, `status --watch/-w/--tui/--follow/--compact`, `plan --decompose/--max-ticket-scope/--no-fast-path`, `review --plan/--loop/--five-lens/--no-arbiter`, `doctor --fix`, structured review schemas (`ARL_FINDING_SCHEMA`, `ARBITER_TRIAGE_SCHEMA`), and `agb_init` / `agb_shape` MCP tools.
     - **PR #158 (`f7870fb`)**: Adapt for `agy 1.5.9` and `@adlc/* 1.13.0`, including Gemini 4 Hydrogen (`gemini-4-hydrogen-flash`, `gemini-4-hydrogen-pro`), Gemini 4 Carbon (`gemini-4-carbon-low`, `gemini-4-carbon-medium`, `gemini-4-carbon-high`), and orchestrator (`gemini-pro-orchestrator`, `gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon`) model catalog expansion in `lib/models.mjs`.
     - **PR #160 (`a688261`)**: Post-PR-159 cross-model adversarial review hardening — `bin/hook-runner.sh` PATH/binary pinning, lazy `PASSWD_HOME` resolution and batched `find` UID verification, fail-closed headless worker when the UID verifier is unavailable, and `verifyStagedPasswdHomeAnchoring` evaluation test coverage.
     - **PR #161 (`38a0e72`)**: Harden Git buffer and worktree integrity checks (`lib/scheduler.mjs`, `lib/scheduler-verify.mjs`, `lib/run-integrity.mjs`), CWD environment variable isolation in `lib/agy.mjs`, `adlc-gemini` companion plugin handshake support (`lib/plugin-paths.mjs`), and `/dev/null` redirect handling in `hooks/policy/shell.mjs`.
     - **Release audit 1.3.0 hardening batch (`T-AUDIT-1`..`T-AUDIT-5`)**:
       - `T-AUDIT-1`: Fail-closed `compilePlan` / `writeAdlcTickets` on symlink-refusal or ticket-store integrity/write errors (`lib/plan.mjs`); degraded arbiter warning and `arbiterDegraded: true` / `arbiterError` fields in `triageFindings` (`lib/review.mjs`); flag-skipping `npm run` / `npm run-script` regex in `extractDelegatedScripts` (`lib/plan-integrity.mjs`).
       - `T-AUDIT-2`: Strict positive-integer `--interval` validation in `agb status` and `agb watch`, unknown `--*` flag rejection across all `bin/agb.mjs` subcommands (`plan`, `review`, `preflight`, `status`, `watch`, `bootstrap`, `doctor`, `sync-models`, `validate`), and `.git`/`.adlc` repository guard in `applyDoctorFixes` (`lib/doctor.mjs`).
       - `T-AUDIT-3`: Sandboxed post-merge Pass 2 `adlc hollow-test --test-cmd` via `wrapConsensusGateCommand` when `AGB_SANDBOX_GATES !== '0'` (`lib/scheduler.mjs`), and strict sidecar token authentication in `sidecars/server.mjs` and `sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs` (removing the `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT` bypass when an explicit token is passed).
       - `T-AUDIT-4`: Case-insensitive argument normalization (`normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive`) in `evaluateWorkflowTool` (`hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs`), hardened `scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs` static scanner (nested-paren `createRequire(...)`, aliased `createRequire`, `import.meta.resolve(...)`), and OIDC-only Trusted Publishing in `.github/workflows/publish.yml` (removing `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` / `NPM_TOKEN`).
       - `T-AUDIT-5`: Synchronized `skills/adversarial-review/references/models.json` with all 22 models from `lib/models.mjs`, removed unsupported `project`/`cwd` parameters from `agb-run` skill/command docs, and updated CLI/MCP/website reference documentation and bundles.
4. **Update website docs:**
   - `website/content/docs/reference/cli/run.mdx` and `website/content/docs/reference/mcp-tools.mdx`: update prose claiming `agb run` has no concurrency flag (now supports `-c <n>`).
   - `website/content/docs/reference/cli/{doctor,plan,review,status}.mdx`: reflect `doctor [repo] [--fix]`, `plan --decompose/--max-ticket-scope/--no-fast-path`, `review --plan/--loop/--five-lens/--no-arbiter`, and `status -w/--tui/--follow/--compact` + 200ms default watch interval.
   - `website/content/docs/reference/exit-and-error-codes.mdx`: add rows to the `## Per command` table for `shape`, `watch`, `init`, and `sync-models` with their exact numerical exit codes and meanings:
     - `shape`: `0` when pre-analysis passed (`analysis.ok === true`) and optional `--sync-brain` succeeded; `1` on unknown option, missing `<spec.md | id>` argument, unreadable spec/brain, or `--sync-brain` write failure (`runShapeCli` in `lib/shape.mjs`); `2` when pre-analysis found blocking structural/DAG errors or `--strict` coupling/scope warnings (`analysis.ok === false`).
     - `watch`: `0 / 2` when the watched run finishes (`0` if all tickets succeeded, `2` if any ticket failed in `watchStatus` in `lib/status.mjs`); `1` on missing/invalid `--interval` or unknown `--*` flag.
     - `init`: `0` when repository initialization completes (`runInit` in `lib/init.mjs`); `1` on unknown flag or top-level error.
     - `sync-models`: `0` when model catalog audit completes (and `--check` finds 0 unmapped models); `1` on unknown `--*` flag, live `agy models` failure under `--check`, or unmapped live models under `--check` (`unmappedCount > 0` in `syncModels` in `scripts/sync-models.mjs`).
   - `website/content/docs/concepts/pools-and-tiers.mdx`: update `frontier` table and prose to reflect `gemini-pro-orchestrator` / `gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon` frontier routing (`agy >= 1.5.9`, opt-out via `AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR=1` / `plan.disableOrchestrator`).
   - `website/content/docs/reference/{skills,slash-commands,mcp-tools}.mdx` and `website/content/docs/guides/headless-and-mcp.mdx`: update hardcoded counts from `8 skills / 8 commands / 6 MCP tools` to current `17 skills / 16 commands / 8 MCP tools`.
5. **Rebuild bundles & generated website pages:**
   - Run `npm run build` and `node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs`.

#### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `skills/adversarial-review/references/models.json` includes all 22 models from `lib/models.mjs`.
- [ ] `skills/agb-run/SKILL.md` and `commands/agb-run.md` document only `plan` for `mcp__agb__agb_run`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and all listed `website/content/docs/**` pages are updated and `node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run plugin:validate`, `npm run skills:check`, `node scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs`, and `npm test` all pass.
title: Sync models.json, fix agb-run docs, update CHANGELOG/website, rebuild bundles
